Box plots of mean squared error (MSE).

Source: R/bias_mse.R
mse_plot.Rd

Box plots of mean squared error (MSE).

Usage

mse_plot(
  hiv_lists,
  quantity = "incidence",
  offset = 0.1,
  lab = TRUE,
  colours = NULL,
  sim_comparison = c("sampled", "generative"),
  years = NULL
)

Arguments

hiv_lists

A named list of model result lists, each returned from the postproc function. Names are used as model labels. If unnamed, models are labelled "Model 1", "Model 2", etc.

quantity

The quantity to plot MSE for (default is "incidence"). Migration-model options are "undiag_migration", "ratio_abroad_uk", and "mp".

offset

The offset for text labels.

lab

A logical indicating whether to add labels.

colours

An optional named character vector of colours for each model. Names must match the names of hiv_lists. If NULL (default), ggplot's default discrete colour palette is used.

sim_comparison

A string specifying which simulated values to compare against. Options are "sampled" (the stochastic realisation for the particular seed, the default) or "generative" (deterministic expected values).

years

Optional numeric/integer vector specifying which years to include in bias/MSE calculations. If NULL (default), all available years are used.

Value

A ggplot object of the MSE box plot.
